shortDescription.default: Visualize data from multiple sources with various chart types

longDescription.default: SharePoint Smart Charts web part - supports CSV, Excel, SharePoint lists, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, and more with 17 chart types, drill-down, bookmarks, and analytics. No API permissions are declared — the Microsoft Graph data source requires a tenant admin to manually grant Graph scopes via API access; all other data sources work with no permissions.

features.title: SharePoint Smart Charts Feature
features.description: Activates the SharePoint Smart Charts web part.
